notes: All photometric fits exclude interpolated rows.
Parameter errors use the local weighted model Jacobian with absolute measurement errors, without a parameter-error floor. Integrated masses retain interpolation-gap and model-systematic limitations.
Main results, Table 2 and integrated masses use JH-only fits; red-excess fits provide separate context.
The inherited 10% blue-BB setting is a soft penalty, not a hard upper bound. Actual blue fractions are exported in fit_bound_and_coverage_diagnostics.csv.
Local Jacobian errors treat spectral samples as independent; correlated calibration/model systematics are not modeled.
BB radii retain the existing emitting-area convention of the pipeline.

The separate four-panel red-excess correlation figure pairs T/R with MstarMdot/Av from the same joint contextual fit; shared viridis colours encode Gregorian observation year. Photometry derived from spectra is not independent of spectroscopy. Four unidentifiable BB epochs are omitted; complete local errors are retained in the CSV. Axis-aligned errors do not display cross-parameter covariance.

BB temperature/radius are reported as NaN for boundary-asymptotic or rank-deficient fits, or when both local fractional T/R errors exceed 1000%. Evolution triangles indicate errorbars continuing beyond the displayed range; full uncertainties are in the tables. Numerical optimizer candidates are retained separately for audit; these contextual failures do not enter main JH results.

Contextual spectral BB fits require both K and L continuum. Six IRTF epochs refitted from K onward (>=2.0 micron) with inclusive 2.8--3.3 micron ice-water mask; three XSHOOTER and two SXD-only IRTF epochs excluded for lacking L coverage. Main JH and photometric fits unchanged.
visual_review: Four spectral-red-dependent PDFs rendered and visually inspected with six eligible IRTF epochs; seven other PDFs verified unchanged.
